verdict.rationale: Lighthouse says its case platform covers "every step of your case preparation, from uploading documents to tracking what is ready" (supp-platform). The Plus tier lists Candidate Progress Reports, which points to some status visibility, though it appears aimed at employers. Only document-readiness tracking is actually described, not an explicit case-status or next-steps dashboard for the founder. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a client portal or dashboard showing case stage and status (e.g. filed, RFE, approved), documented next-steps guidance in the portal, founder-facing (not just employer) progress views, screenshots or detailed docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
